newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ to lead Brierley MTN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ to lead Brierley MTN.

text.p: ANZ Investment Bank said it has been mandated to arrange a A$500 million medium term note programme for BIL (Australia Finance) Ltd, a wholly owned and guaranteed subsidiary of Brierley Investments Ltd.
The programme would be launched in March with an initial issue of A$200 million.

"The mandate was a further significant step in the expansion of the corporate bond market in Australia. This expanding market provides a range of opportunities for corporates to raise funds," said ANZ Investment Bank's Managing Director, John Sunderland.

"ANZ Investment Bank's mandate reflects our increasing capablility in the origination and distribution of capital market debt in Australia and New Zealand, in addition to our international strengths," he added.
